profile.name: Vignesh Yemul
profile.tagline: Building practical AI-powered workflows, automation pipelines, and API-driven solutions that turn repetitive work into measurable outcomes.
profile.specialization: AI Integration • Workflow Automation • Python • APIs
profile.bio: I'm an AI Automation Specialist with hands-on internship experience building AI-driven workflows and integrating LLMs such as GPT-4-class models and Google AI APIs into production web applications. I work across Python, REST API integration, automated workflows, and process analysis — breaking complex business steps into logical pipelines that reduce manual effort.

experience.summary: Built AI-driven features and automation workflows for an e-commerce and farm-management platform — from API design and LLM integration through deployment-ready backend delivery.
highlights: Engineered and deployed AI-driven features including a product recommendation engine and intelligent search into an e-commerce and farm-management platform.
Integrated Google AI APIs for LLM-based NLP and image recognition into Django web applications.
Designed REST API endpoints consumed by a React frontend.
Automated data-entry and internal management workflows to reduce manual processing.
Audited manual processes and developed automated pipelines from data preprocessing through model integration and deployment.
Preprocessed and validated structured and visual datasets.
Implemented quality assurance and monitoring checks across pipeline stages.
Collaborated remotely while maintaining regular progress reporting and feedback cycles.

projects.title: LMS Automation Platform
projects.subtitle: Moodle API Integration
projects.description: Built an automated workflow layer on top of a Moodle-based Learning Management System using the Moodle Web Services REST API — turning repetitive admin work into scheduled, token-authenticated Python pipelines.
features: Scheduled jobs with error handling & monitoring
projects.impact: Automated repetitive administrative tasks and reduced manual administrative effort by an estimated ~50%.

projects.title: AI-Nexus
projects.subtitle: Multi-model AI Integration Platform
projects.description: A multi-model AI integration platform built with Django and REST APIs — providing modular wrappers for Google AI models across NLP, image recognition, and generative AI workflows.
features: Integration of multiple Google AI models
Django backend with REST API architecture
projects.impact: Reduced integration time for new AI models by approximately 60% compared with direct API integrations and was deployed/tested across 3 use-case domains.

projects.title: Movie Recommendation System
projects.subtitle: ML Pipeline
projects.description: Designed and implemented a hybrid recommendation engine combining user-user similarity, item-item similarity, global averages, and matrix factorization on cleaned interaction data.
features: Compared recommendation approaches with documented rationale
projects.impact: Improved measurable accuracy using matrix factorization against a global-average baseline, with reproducible model-selection documentation.
